messages.author: c007f6298a38045f
messages.subject: downloadHandler and saveGIF
parts:
Hello,

I have a problem when using downloadHandler and saveGIF{animation} in server.r :

  output$downloadGif <- downloadHandler(
    filename = 'Persp.gif',
    content  = function(file) {
      saveGIF(
        for (i in 1:3) {
        persp(F()[ , , i], col = "green")
      })
    }) 

I think it has something to do with the output directory and 'file' but I have no idea how to fix it (when using saveGIF one can set the output directiory by adding ani.options(outdir = getwd()) before saveGIF(...)).


Any suggestions how to make it work?

messages.author: fa8b9dad524607ca
messages.subject: Re: downloadHandler and saveGIF
parts:
I should start by saying this is a shot in the dark on my part- I hope it works out for you.  But in some examples it explicitly defines the content type, such as

  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({ myplot() })

  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = 'myplots.png',
    content = function(file) {
      png(file, width = 1000, height = 1000, units = "px", pointsize = 12, bg = "white", res = NA)
      myplot()
      dev.off()
    },
    contentType = 'image/png'
  )
})

maybe contentType='gif' or 'image/gif' would help? 

Also, is it saving the .gif on the server, or when run locally, successfully?

Good luck!

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: downloadHandler and saveGIF
parts:
There is indeed annoyance about the output directory of the animation
package, and I have been hoping to fix that
(https://github.com/yihui/animation/issues/31). For now, I think what
you can try is:

library(animation)
ani.options(outdir = getwd())

output$downloadGif <- downloadHandler(
filename = 'Persp.gif',
content = function(file) {
saveGIF(
for (i in 1:3) {
persp(F()[ , , i], col = "green")

}, movie.name = 'Persp.gif')
})

Please let me know if this works.

Regards,
Yihui
